title: Deep learning-based reconstruction for three-dimensional volumetric brain MRI: a qualitative and quantitative assessment.
summary: Deep-learning reconstruction enabled 3D brain MRI acceleration to 33.5% of reference scan time; in 22 patients DLR-CS4 image quality was comparable to CS2 across reported metrics, with volunteer volumetric and reader comparisons.
